children: is set to host its investor day on Sept. 30, and BNP Paribas believes it could be a “positive catalyst” for the stock. As such, the investment firm upgraded the electronic design automation firm to Neutral from Undperform.
Shares fell 1.3% in early trading on Thursday.

“While AI disruption concerns are more pronounced for Synopsys now (-15% YTD), some headwinds around Intel/China are improving, Ansys integration is progressing well, and an Investor Day on Sep. 30 could be a positive catalyst,” analyst Andrew DeGasperi wrote in a note to clients. “With the valuation gap to its closest peer Cadence having widened, and Ansys a free option at 3.8% CY27 FCFY, we see limited downside risk.”
Delving deeper, DeGasperi said the threat of artificial intelligence disruption is “not yet grounded in reality” in its core business, but it could hurt its industrial simulation business.

“Reported advances in geometric design from new AI model companies are hurting traditional engineering software stocks and we don't see that narrative changing near term (we note Ansys is a partner to Dassault Systemes),” DeGasperi added. “Further, we are still skeptical that Ansys' low double-digit growth may not be sustainable at these levels for long.”

title: Synopsys in focus as BNP Paribas upgrades, says investor day could be 'positive catalyst'
